name_cn: 绍兴凯明纺织品有限公司
main_products: Woven imitation silk, satin, SPH, imitation acetate, lyocell/modal and recycled fabrics; also knitted and printed fabrics
woven_evidence: Its own site lists woven fabric first and says the group owns its own woven and knitted weaving factories, with output above 150 million m a year.

canton_fair.evidence_note: China Textile News (2026-05-06, from Keqiao Daily) names 凯明纺织 among the 246 Keqiao companies exhibiting at Phase 3 of the 139th Canton Fair.

notes: Business contacts published on its site: sales@sxkaiming.com and +86-575-85573053. It has a large knit line, so Layer 2 should check that woven is the main share. It names no Middle East markets.
